To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) appliance efficiency policies are a significant source of greenhouse gas emission reduction, 2) appliance efficiency policies have the potential to reduce energy demand by 17 % in the year 2030, 3) the potential for greenhouse gas emission mitigation is greatest in the residential sector, 4) appliance efficiency policies in the industrial sector have the greatest potential to reduce energy intensity, and 5) energy savings from appliance efficiency policies are greatest in China, India, and the United States.
appliance efficiency policies can achieve significant energy savings and greenhouse gas emissions reductions, with the largest impacts in the largest economies.

the Bottom–Up Energy and Greenhouse Gas Analysis System (BUENGAS) is a new model for calculating the potential energy and greenhouse gases emission impacts of efficiency standards and labeling policies for lighting, appliances, and heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and industrial equipment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a tool to estimate the impact of appliance efficiency policy on global electricity consumption and greenhouse gas emissions.
the potential for appliance efficiency to reduce energy demand and carbon emissions in the near term.
how to best design policies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from appliances and equipment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the appliance efficiency policy scenario would reduce global energy demand by 2.4 % and greenhouse gas emissions by 17 % by 2030.

the BUENAS model is a useful tool for evaluating the potential energy and greenhouse mitigation of appliance efficiency policies, and that it is capable of producing results that can be used to support policy making.
the appliance efficiency policy package has a significant potential to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and energy use, but that this potential is not yet realized in most countries.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
BUENAS is the most comprehensive appliance efficiency policy model in existence and can be used to estimate potential energy and emissions mitigation for a range of countries.
we have developed a tool to help policymakers and researchers understand the impact of energy efficiency policies on energy demand and greenhouse gas emissions.

we have developed an international appliance efficiency policy analysis tool that can be applied to any country or region and that we have used the model to calculate the energy and emissions savings that would result from the adoption of current best practices in efficiency policies for appliances and equipment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
appliance energy efficiency policy can have a substantial impact in reducing greenhouse gas emissions.
the potential for efficiency policy is substantial.
the potential for efficiency policy is large, and that it can be quantified with a relatively simple tool.
